name: Donor Services Resolution Swarm
tag: AI agents that clear donor receipt delays, missed gift confirmations and urgent donor questions for nonprofits.

scenarios.title: Clear the receipt backlog
scenarios.ask: {backlog} donors are waiting on gift receipts. Clear the backlog before the end of the month.
steps: Matched {=round(backlog * 0.9)} gifts to donor records. {=backlog - round(backlog * 0.9)} have a name or address mismatch.
Generated receipts from your approved template with gift date and amount.
Checked each against the payment record before sending.
Drafted a short apology note for donors waiting more than 14 days.
followups: No. It uses the receipt wording your organization and its advisors approved. It doesn't give tax advice to donors.
They go to a short review list with the likely match suggested, so a staff member can fix each in a minute or two.

scenarios.title: Missed recurring gift confirmations
scenarios.ask: About {missed}% of our {donors} monthly donors didn't get a confirmation last month.
steps: Traced the gap: a payment processor update changed the email trigger on the 12th.
Drafted a thank-you that explains the delay plainly.
Added a daily check that every processed gift has a confirmation.
followups: Will donors be annoyed by a late email?
A short, honest note usually lands well. Donors are more upset by silence than a late thank-you.
Can it catch this sooner next time?
Yes. The daily check would flag the gap within 24 hours.

scenarios.title: Urgent donor questions
scenarios.ask: We get about {questions} donor questions a week, and {urgent}% are urgent, like duplicate charges.
steps: Sorted questions. {=round(questions * urgent / 100)} urgent, such as duplicate charges and cancel requests.
Pulled the donor's gift history for each case.
Drafted replies for routine questions like address changes.
Sent urgent money issues to a staff member with all details attached.
followups: No. Agents gather the facts and draft the reply, and a staff member approves any refund.
Does it work with our donor database?
It connects to common donor databases or works from exports, with read-only access to start.
